description: SDK contract requirements for Aether identity continuity — defines the minimum fields every SDK (web, React, React Native, iOS, Android, server/API) must emit for late binding identity resolution. Per blueprint §14.1-14.3.

blocks.name: sdk_ingestion
blocks.description: Minimum SDK event payload for identity continuity late binding.

fields.name: tenant_app_key
fields.description: Tenant/app key — identifies the SDK instance.

fields.name: source_namespace
fields.description: Source namespace for this SDK event (e.g. web_sdk:marketing_site, ios_sdk:consumer_app).

fields.name: sdk_name
fields.description: SDK name (aether-web, aether-react, aether-ios, aether-android, aether-server).

fields.name: sdk_version
fields.description: SDK version string.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Unique event identifier — used for idempotency.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.description: Event retry key. For SDK identify events, equals the top-level event_id and is retained with the queued event across retries. V1 batch canonical resolution deduplicates by tenant + top-level event_id + schema with a 24-hour Redis claim, failing closed for identify if the claim store is unavailable; V2 uses durable tenant/event/schema uniqueness and an at-least-once outbox. This does not guarantee exactly-once resolution. The separate POST /sdk/identify request also requires this field in its request body.

fields.name: anonymous_id
fields.description: Anonymous ID — present for anonymous events.

fields.name: installation_id
fields.description: Installation ID — mobile SDKs.

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: Session ID.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: User ID — present after identify() call.

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: Device ID — mobile SDKs.

fields.name: app_instance_id
fields.description: App instance ID — mobile SDKs.

fields.name: occurred_at
fields.description: When the event occurred (client clock).

fields.name: sent_at
fields.description: When the event was sent (client clock).

fields.name: ingested_at
fields.description: When Aether ingested the event (server clock).

fields.name: consent_state
fields.description: Consent state at time of event. {grant_id, purposes, status: valid|missing|revoked|unknown}.

fields.name: traits
fields.description: User traits from identify() call. traits.email, traits.phone, traits.name if available.

fields.name: traits_email
fields.description: Email from traits — extracted for identity claim.

fields.name: traits_phone
fields.description: Phone from traits — extracted for identity claim.

fields.name: traits_name
fields.description: Name from traits — extracted for identity claim.

fields.name: verification_status
fields.description: Verification status of traits if available (verified, unverified, unknown).

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Event name (heartbeat, page, track, identify, alias, reset, consent).

fields.name: properties
fields.description: Event properties.

fields.name: heartbeat
fields.description: Send a heartbeat to prove SDK is active.

fields.name: track
fields.description: Send an event with name and properties.

fields.name: identify
fields.description: Identify a user — binds anonymous_id to user_id.

fields.name: alias
fields.description: Alias previousId to userId — backward compatibility.

fields.name: reset
fields.description: Reset identity context — clears anonymous_id.

fields.name: setConsent
fields.description: Set consent state.

fields.name: flush
fields.description: Flush pending events.

blocks.name: mobile_sdk_additional
blocks.description: Mobile SDK additional requirements per blueprint §14.1.

fields.name: installation_id
fields.description: Mobile installation ID — required for iOS/Android.

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: Device ID — required for iOS/Android.

fields.name: app_instance_id
fields.description: App instance ID — required for iOS/Android.

fields.name: offline_queue
fields.description: Offline event queue — mobile SDKs.

fields.name: retry_idempotency
fields.description: Retry with idempotency — mobile SDKs.

blocks.name: sdk_identify_request
blocks.description: Direct POST /sdk/identify retry contract. SDK hydrateIdentity methods emit identify events through POST /v1/batch instead; their properties.idempotency_key equals the event ID and stays in the queue for retries. For direct endpoint requests the idempotency key is required and tenant-scoped; identical completed retries replay the stored outcome, concurrent requests remain in_progress, pending claims without an update for 15 minutes return stale for operator reconciliation, and key reuse with a changed payload returns HTTP 409. Candidate or blocked imported identity evidence stops before canonical resolver execution. A stale claim is not proof the worker stopped and is not automatically replayed or cleared. Route side effects do not share one transaction/outbox, so this is not an exactly-once guarantee.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.description: Caller-supplied retry key, 1–255 characters, scoped to the authenticated tenant.

fields.name: idempotency_status
fields.description: Response status: completed, replayed, in_progress, or stale.

fields.name: anonymous_activity
fields.description: SDK sends anonymous events before identify.

fields.name: identify_call
fields.description: identify(userId, traits) binds anonymous history to imported/canonical profile if safe.

fields.name: no_sdk_canonical_decision
fields.description: The SDK must NOT decide the canonical profile — backend resolves.
